script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Sci-Fi
Theme: small-town life

Begin screenplay.

---

Title: "The Light"

INT. SMALL TOWN - NIGHT

(A gentle rain falls. STARS twinkle above as quiet CRICKETS sing in the background.)

(The sound of a car engine growing louder as it approaches.)

EXT. SMALL TOWN - NIGHT (Main Street)

(The car, an old sedan, rolls to a stop in front of the town sign. An ASTRONAUT in a white suit, JAMES, steps out and gazes at the town with awe.)

JAMES
(whispering to himself)
Home sweet home.

---

INT. JAMES' HOUSE - DAY

(James enters his childhood home. He is greeted by his SISTER, LUCY, with open arms.)

LUCY
(surprised)
James! I had no idea you were coming back!

JAMES
(smiling)
I had to see the town that shaped me.

---

EXT. SMALL TOWN - NIGHT

(James sits on the porch of the town hall, watching the stars. LUCY joins him.)

LUCY
I'm glad you're back, James. It's been so long.

JAMES
I know, Lucy. But I've been on a mission to find something. Something that could change the world.

---

INT. RESEARCH FACILITY - DAY

(James meets with a team of SCIENTISTS, led by DR. ROSA. They are working on a groundbreaking technology called "The Light." It's a machine that harnesses the power of the sun to create clean, limitless energy.)

---

EXT. SMALL TOWN - DAY

(James shares his discovery with the townsfolk. They are hesitant at first but eventually warm up to the idea.)

---

INT. SMALL TOWN - NIGHT

(A town meeting is held to discuss the implementation of "The Light." Tensions rise as some fear the change.)

---

EXT. SMALL TOWN - DAY

(Construction on the town's "The Light" facility begins. James works alongside the townsfolk.)

---

INT. SMALL TOWN - NIGHT

(The town comes together for a grand lighting ceremony. The sun's energy illuminates the town, leaving everyone in awe.)

---

EXT. SMALL TOWN - DAY

(Months later, James and Lucy sit on the porch, watching the sun set. The town is thriving, and the world has taken notice.)

JAMES
(smiling)
Look at what we've done, Lucy.

LUCY
(teary-eyed)
You always were a dreamer, James.

---

INT. RESEARCH FACILITY - DAY

(James and Dr. Rosa receive an award for their groundbreaking invention. They celebrate their success with the team.)

---

EXT. SMALL TOWN - NIGHT

(The stars twinkle above as James and Lucy walk through the town, hand in hand. The soft glow of "The Light" illuminates their path.)

JAMES
(smiling)
It's good to be home.

---

FADE OUT.

---

End of screenplay.
